stops.name: Traunsee
stops.detail: Gmunden lies on the northern shore of Traunsee and has a long history dating back to the Middle Ages. A stroll through the old town reveals well-preserved historic buildings, narrow lanes and picturesque squares. Gmunden is often described as both romantic and lively – a perfect place to enjoy coffee by the lakeside promenade, take in the mountain views and soak up the Alpine atmosphere.
